description: This Java interface defines configuration settings for the 'thingsearch' update process within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides method signatures for retrieving configurable parameters such as idle time, bulk size, polling interval, and activation status, along with an internal enum for default configuration values.

classes.name: UpdaterConfig
classes.description: An immutable interface providing accessors for updater configuration parameters for the 'thingsearch' functionality.

classes.name: UpdaterConfig.UpdaterConfigValue
classes.description: An enum implementing KnownConfigValue with default configuration paths and values for UpdaterConfig.

methods.name: getMaxIdleTime
methods.description: Returns the maximum idle time duration for a ThingUpdater.

methods.name: getMaxBulkSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of write operations to perform in a single bulk operation.

methods.name: getShardingStatePollInterval
methods.description: Returns the interval duration at which sharding state is polled.

methods.name: isEventProcessingActive
methods.description: Indicates whether event processing is active.

methods.name: getBackgroundSyncConfig
methods.description: Provides configuration details for the background sync actor.
